content.comment_body: Hello, I have an FBD program that records when a button is pressed and counts inputs from two signals, displaying this information on the built-in LCD. I am trying to transfer this data into Excel (2016). Is there a compatible Excel add-on or another method available? I attempted to use Excel's 'data from web' option by entering the device's IP address, but was only able to view a table without any actual data.
Here is a section from the manual of [product_name] [product_name] [version_no]: The [product_name] supports these Excel versions and modules: Office Excel 2007, 2010, 2013 (both 32-bit and 64-bit).
Thank you. Where can I download the tool? I tried accessing it from [company_name]'s website but registration confirmation is still pending. Is there an alternative source to download it?

It seems there was a misunderstanding. The information listed only mentions Excel versions which have been officially tested and approved, and Excel 2016 is not included. Still, if you want to proceed, note that the tool is not currently available for direct download. You should submit a Support Request and consult [company_name] for further help.

Hello, the [product_name] is included in the [product_name] [version_no] SP1 upgrade, which can be downloaded from [url]. This update features: [product_name] [version_no] (SP1) with [product_name] V1.01 and [product_name], plus new firmware for all relevant modules with order number: [article_no]. If your unit has an older firmware, you can't update it, but the software supports all versions. Alternatively, if you have an installation DVD for [product_name] V8.x, the tool can be found in the folder 'DVD/tools'. Hope this information is useful.

analysis.insight_summary: Users want to transfer real-time logs and sensor data from [product_name] hardware to Microsoft Excel for further processing and record-keeping. Compatibility challenges arise with newer Excel versions, while unclear integration procedures and limited access to export tools make implementation difficult for users seeking automation.
analysis.user_expectations: The user is looking for an efficient way to directly import real-time data from [product_name] into Excel 2016, preferably through an official solution or add-on. They expect clear instructions and accessible downloads so that integration between [product_name] data and Excel can be set up quickly.
